'''Billy Dexter''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a [[:Category:Radio DJs|radio show host]] in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is voiced by [[Peter Marx]].

==Character history==
Billy Dexter is, in [[1992]], the host of the [[Entertaining America]] show on [[West Coast Talk Radio]], a talk radio station although he had wanted to call the show "''Stack the Dex''".  He planned to interview [[Richard Goblin]], a chef, before being fatally and accidentally shot by [[Jack Howitzer]]. Dexter was later replaced by [[Lazlow Jones|Lazlow]], with Howitzer later be put on trial for the murder of Dexter.

==Trivia==
*Billy Dexter is evidently a follower of the [[Epsilon Program]] as he uses their saying "Kifflom".
*Billy Dexter has a star on the [[Vinewood Walk of Fame]] in [[Grand Theft Auto V]].
